senses.gloss:
कुक् कुक्, cl. 1. A. कोकते, चुकुके, कोकितुम्,
to take, accept, seize: Desid. चुकोकिषते
or चुकुकिषते.
कुक, अस्, आ, अम्, taking, accepting.
कुकथा कु-कथा, f. a bad, miserable tale.

कुकभ कुकभ, अम्, n. a kind of spirituous
liquor.

कुकर कु-कर, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. कु) , having
a crooked or withered arm; acting wickedly, wicked.

कुकर्मन् कु-कर्मन्, अ, n. (see 1. कु), a
wicked deed; wickedness, depravity, villainy; (आ, आ,
अ), performing evil actions, wicked, depraved.
—कु-
कर्म-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wicked, depraved.
कु-कार्य, अम्, n. a bad action, sin, wickedness.

कुकीर्त्ति कु-कीर्त्ति, इस्, f. (see 1. कु), ill-re-
pute, notoriety.

कुकुट कुकुट, अस्, m., N. of a pot-herb, =
सितावर, commonly सुषणिशाक, Marsilea Quadri-
folia.

कुक्कुट कुक्कुट, अस्, m. a cock, a wild cock;
a whisp of lighted straw or grass, a firebrand, a spark
of fire; the offspring of a Niṣāda by a Śūdra woman
or woman of the fourth caste; (इस् or ई), f. hypocrisy,
interested observance of religious duties; (ई), f. a
hen; a small house-lizard; the silk-cotton tree,
Bombax Heptaphyllum, or the red cotton tree, Sal-
malia Malabarica.
—कुक्कुट-कन्थ, अम्, n., N. of
a town.
—कुक्कुट-ध्वनि, इस्, m. the crowing of
a cock, the cackling of fowls.
—कुक्कुट-पक्षक,
अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?), a knife shaped like the
wing of a cock.
—कुक्कुट-पाद, अस्, m., N. of a
mountain (cock-foot).
—कुक्कुट-मण्डप, अस्,
m., N. of a sanctuary in Benares standing on the
right side of a statue of Śiva, a place where final
emancipation may be attained; [cf. मुक्ति-मण्ड-
प.]
—कुक्कुट-मस्तक, अस्, m. a sort of pepper,
Piper Chaba.
—कुक्कुट-व्रत, अम्, n. a religious
observance (worship of Śiva) on the seventh of the
light fortnight of the month Bhādra, by women,
especially for the sake of obtaining offspring.
—कुक्-
कुट-शिख, अस्, m. safflower, Carthamus Tinctorius
(cockscomb).
—कुक्कुटा-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a moun-
tain.
—कुक्कुटाण्ड (˚ट-अण्˚), अम्, n. a fowl's egg.
—कुक्कुटाण्डक, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?), a
species of rice.
—कुक्कुटाभ (˚ट-आभा), अस्, m. a
kind of snake compared to a fowl (perhaps from
having a crest or comb).
—कुक्कुटाराम (˚ट-आर्˚),
अस्, m., N. of a grove; N. of a celebrated hermitage
near Gayā.
—कुक्कुटार्म (˚ट-अर्˚), अम्, n., N.
of a place.
—कुक्कुटासन (˚ट-आस्˚), अम्, n. a
particular posture of an ascetic in religious medita-
tion.
—कुक्कुटाहि (˚ट-अहि), इस्, m. = कुक्कुटाभ
above.
—कुक्कुटी-व्रत, अम्, n. a ceremony in
honour of Śiva and Durgā; see कुक्कुट-व्रत.

कुकुटुम्बिनी कु-कुटुम्बिनी, f. a bad house-
wife.

कुकुद कुकुद, अस्, m. one who gives away
a girl in marriage after decoration with fit ornaments
and the prescribed ceremonies; also कूकुद, q. v.

कूकुद कूकुद, अस्, m. one who gives a girl
in marriage with due ceremony and suitable decora-
tions.

कुकुन्दर कुकुन्दर or कुकुन्दुर, अम्, n.,
or ए, du. n. the cavities of the loins just above the
hips [cf. ककुन्दर]; (अस्), m., N. of a plant, =
कुक्कुर-द्रु, q. v.

कुकुन्ध कुकुन्ध, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a
kind of evil spirit.

कुकुभा कुकुभा, f. one of the female per-
sonifications of music or Rāgiṇīs.

कुक्कुभ कुक्कुभ, अस्, m. a wild cock, Pha-
sianus Gallus; varnish, oily gloss.

कुकुर कुकुर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कुक्),
a dog; N. of a plant and perfume, = ग्रन्थि-पर्णी;
N. of a prince, a son of Andhaka; (आस्), m. pl. the
[]
descendants of this prince; N. of a people, a branch
of the Yadu race or Yādavas; the country of this
people; [cf. कुक्कुर and कौकुर.]
—कुकुर-
जिह्वा, f. a species of fish, Acheiris Kookor Zibha;
the plant Leea Staphylea; another plant, Ixora
Undulata.
—कुकुराधिनाथ (˚र-अध्˚), अस्, m.
lord of the Yādavas, an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.

कुक्कुर कुक्कुर, अस्, m. (a more modern form
for कुकुर), a dog; N. of a Muni; also of a prince,
a son of Andhaka; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (ई),
f. a bitch; (अम्), n. a vegetable perfume; [cf.
ग्रन्थि-पर्ण.]
—कुक्कुर-द्रु, उस्, m., N. of a
plant, = ताम्र-चूड.

कुकूटी कुकूटी, f. the plant Salmalia Mala-
barica; [cf. शाल्मलि.]

कुकूणक कुकूणक, अस्, m. a kind of disease
of the eyes in infants.

कुकूनन कुकूनन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (an
onomatopoetic word), gargling.

कुकूरभ कुकूरभ, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of
evil spirit.

कुकूल कुकूल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. chaff,
conflagration of chaff, a fire made of chaff; (अम्), n.
a hole filled with stakes; armour, mail.

कुकृत्य कु-कृत्य, अम्, n. (see 1. कु), an evil
deed, evil, wickedness.

कुकोल कुकोल, अम्, n. the jujube, Zizyphus
Jujuba; [cf. कोलि.]

कुक्कुटक, अस्, m. a cock, a wild cock; a man of
a mixed caste, one sprung from a Śūdra and a Niṣāda
woman.

कुक्कुवाच् कुक्कु-वाच्, क्, m. (fr. कुक्कु, an
onomatopoetic word, and वाच्), a kind of deer, =
सारङ्ग-मृग.

कुक्रिया कु-क्रिया, f. (see 1. कु), a bad
action; (अस्, आ, अम्), wicked, sinful.

कुक्ष कुक्ष, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कुष्),
the belly.

कुक्षि, इस्, m. the belly, the cavity of the abdomen
(in the earlier language generally used in dual); the
interior of anything; the womb, the part of the belly
containing the fœtus; a cavity in general (e. g. अद्रि-
कुक्षि, cavity of a mountain); the cavity of the
ocean, i. e. a bay, a gulf; a cavern; N. of a son (f.
also of a daughter?) of Priya-vrata and Kāmyā; N.
of Bali; of a king; of a son of Ikṣvāku and father
of Vikukṣi; N. of a region; according to a native
lexicographer कुक्षि means also the sheath of a
sword, and steel; [cf. Lat. coxa, coxendix; Gr.
κοχώνη? Old Germ. bûh; Mod. Germ. Bauch.]
—कुक्षिम्-भरि, इस्, इस्, इ, one who nourishes only
his belly, filling or pampering the belly, voracious,
gluttonous.
—कुक्षि-रन्ध्र, अस्, m. a kind of
reed.
—कुक्षि-शूल, अस्, m. pain in the belly, belly-
ache, colic.
कुक्षिल, अस्, m., Ved. a species of evil spirit.
कुक्षितकि कुक्षितकि, इस्, m., N. of a man.

कुक्षेयु कुक्षेयु, उस्, m., N. of a son of
Raudrāśva; (according to others कक्षेयु.)
कुक्षि-ज, अस्, m. a son, (Raghu-v. XV. 15.)
